## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/grid`.

### `GridColumnComponent`

**Selector:** `mona-grid-column`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aggregate` | `AggregateFunction \| null` | `null` | The aggregate shown in the grid footer for this column. |
| `editable` | `boolean \| null` | `null` | Whether this column is editable when the grid is in edit mode. Left unset, every column is editable except the one whose `field` is the grid's `rowKey`. |
| `field` | `string` | `""` | The field name of the data property to display in this column. |
| `filterable` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether this column can be filtered when grid filtering is enabled. Has no effect if filtering is disabled on the grid. |
| `format` | `ColumnFormat \| null` | — | Formats the displayed cell value. String formats apply to date columns and their date filters; formatter functions replace the cell text. |
| `hidden` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether this column is hidden from the rendered grid. |
| `locked` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether this column remains fixed while the grid scrolls horizontally. |
| `lockedPosition` | `GridColumnLockedPosition` | `"left"` | The side of the grid where this locked column is fixed. |
| `maxWidth` | `number \| null` | `null` | The maximum width of this column in pixels. |
| `minWidth` | `number` | `40` | The minimum width of this column in pixels. |
| `sortable` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether this column can be sorted through its header when grid sorting is enabled. Has no effect if sorting is disabled on the grid. |
| `sortComparator` | `ColumnSortComparator \| null` | `null` | Compares two values of this column when the user sorts it, returning a negative number, zero or a positive number. Without it, values sort by type (empty values first) and strings by the locale. |
| `stateKey` | `string \| null` | `null` | A stable key used to persist state for columns whose field is empty or unstable. |
| `title` | `string` | `""` | The title displayed in the column header. |
| `type` | `DataType` | `"string"` | The data type of the column. Determines the edit component and filter behavior. |
| `width` | `number \| null` | — | The fixed width of this column in pixels. If not set, the column width is calculated automatically. |

### `GridComponent`

**Selector:** `mona-grid`  
**Type parameters:** `T`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ariaLabel` | `string \| null` | `null` | The grid's accessible name, such as "Orders". Use it, or `ariaLabelledBy`, rather than an `aria-label` attribute on the host, which names nothing. |
| `ariaLabelledBy` | `string \| null` | `null` | The id of the element that names the grid, such as a heading above it. |
| `class` | `string` | `""` | Additional CSS classes merged onto the host element via `tailwind-merge`. |
| `data` | `Iterable<T>` | `[]` | The row data to be displayed in the grid. |
| `expandedKeys` (two-way) | `unknown[]` | `[]` | Keys of the rows whose detail row is open: `rowKey` values, or the data items when the grid has no `rowKey`. Supports two-way binding; `expandedKeysChange` emits when the user opens or closes one. |
| `pageSize` (two-way) | `number` | — | The number of items to be displayed on a page. Values that aren't positive integers are ignored. A new size keeps the first row of the current page in view. Supports two-way binding. |
| `pageSizeValues` | `number[]` | `[]` | The page sizes that the user can select from. These values will be displayed in the page size dropdown. |
| `resizeMethod` | `ResizeMethod` | `"fitView"` | The method to be used to set initial column widths. It can be the following values: - `fitView`: The columns will be resized to fit the available width. - `auto`: The columns will be resized based on the content. - A number representing the width of the columns. All columns except the columns with a specified width will have the same width. |
| `responsivePager` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the pager is responsive. If set to `true`, the pager will be displayed as a dropdown when the grid width gets smaller. |
| `rounded` | `"large" \| "medium" \| "none" \| "small"` | `"medium"` | The border radius of the grid. |
| `rowClass` | `GridRowClass<T> \| null` | `null` | Returns extra CSS classes for the data row that shows an item, merged onto the row's own classes via `tailwind-merge`. It runs again whenever the item's row is rebound. Group, group footer and detail rows are not affected. To dim a row, prefer a text style such as `text-muted-foreground` over `opacity`: locked cells stay opaque so scrolled cells pass beneath them, and opacity on the row or its cells would let those show through. |
| `rowKey` | `GridKeySelector<unknown> \| null` | `null` | Field name or selector used to derive a stable identity for each row. The resolved value must be unique within the grid data. |
| `skip` (two-way) | `number` | `0` | The number of rows before the current page, in client paging. Supports two-way binding. With `monaGridServerBinding`, the directive's `skip` sets the page and this model reports user changes. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `expandedKeysChange` | `unknown[]` | Emitted when `expandedKeys` changes. |
| `pageChange` | `PageChangeEvent` | Emitted when the user changes the page or the page size, and when the grid moves back to the last page because the data shrank. Not emitted for `skip` or `pageSize` values set from code. |
| `pageSizeChange` | `number` | Emitted when `pageSize` changes. |
| `skipChange` | `number` | Emitted when `skip` changes. |

### `GridEditableDirective`

**Selector:** `mona-grid[monaGridEditable]`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `monaGridEditable` | `EditableOptions \| ""` | `""` | Enables inline editing. An empty string enables cell-mode editing with default settings; pass an object to choose `"cell"` or `"row"` mode and an optional validation `schema`. |
| `newRowFactory` | `() => Record<PropertyKey, unknown>` | — | Creates the initial data object used by the add-row editor. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `add` | `GridAddEvent` | Emitted before the grid displays the new-row editor. |
| `cancel` | `GridCancelEvent` | Emitted before an edit operation is canceled; `reason` says why. Prevent it to keep editing, except for `"removed"`, when the edited row left the data or the view. |
| `cellEdit` | `CellEditEvent` | Emitted before a changed cell is saved in cell mode; not when the value didn't change. `rowData` is the row as it was; persist from `save`, whose `rowData` holds the edited values. |
| `edit` | `GridEditEvent` | Emitted before a row enters edit mode. |
| `remove` | `GridRemoveEvent` | Emitted when a row remove command is triggered, with the row's `key` and `index`. |
| `rowEdit` | `RowEditEvent` | Emitted after a changed row is saved (row mode only). |
| `save` | `GridSaveEvent` | Emitted before an edited or new row is saved; not when an edit changed nothing. `rowData` holds the edited values and `originalRowData` the row as it was. Prevent it to keep the editor open, for example while saving on the server, then call `endEdit()`. |

#### Methods

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `endEdit(): void` | Closes the current edit without reporting it, such as after a `save` that was prevented to save on the server has finished. |

**Selector:** `mona-grid[monaGridStatePersistence]`  
**Exported as:** `monaGridStatePersistence`

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stateChange` | `GridState \| null` | Emitted when `state` changes. |

#### Methods

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `captureState(): GridState` | Captures the grid's current state (columns, sort, filter, group) without waiting for the next change cycle. |
| `loadState(state: GridState \| null, options: GridStatePersistenceOptions = this.#resolveOptions()): GridStateLoadResult` | Applies a previously captured state to the grid. A state that isn't well formed (a missing array, a duplicate column id, an unknown filter operator, a page size or width that isn't a positive number) returns `rejected-invalid` and changes nothing. |

### `GridSortableDirective`

**Selector:** `mona-grid[monaGridSortable]`

#### `GRID_DEFAULT_MESSAGES`

```typescript
const GRID_DEFAULT_MESSAGES: { all: string; apply: string; cancel: string; cancelNewRow: string; cancelRowEdit: (rowNumber: number) => string; clearFilter: (column: string) => string; collapseDetail: (rowNumber: number) => string; columnGrouped: (column: string) => string; columnMoved: (column: string, position: number) => string; columns: string; columnsSelected: (count: number) => string; commandColumnTitle: string; delete: string; deleteRowConfirmation: (rowNumber: number) => string; deleteRowTitle: string; details: string; dragColumnHeaderToGroup: string; edit: string; editRow: (rowNumber: number) => string; expandDetail: (rowNumber: number) => string; fieldValidationError: string; filterByColumn: (column: string) => string; filterByColumnFiltered: (column: string) => string; filterOperator: (column: string, operator: string) => string; filterPlaceholder: string; group: string; groupOptions: (column: string) => string; loading: string; modified: string; moveAsNext: string; moveAsPrevious: string; moveRow: string; noData: string; remove: string; removeRow: (rowNumber: number) => string; reorderRow: (rowNumber: number) => string; resizeColumn: (column: string) => string; rowReorder: string; rowReorderDisabled: string; rowReorderDisabledEditing: string; rowReorderDisabledFiltered: string; rowReorderDisabledGrouped: string; rowReorderDisabledServerBinding: string; rowReorderDisabledSingleRow: string; rowReorderDisabledSorted: string; rowReorderDisabledVirtualScroll: string; rowReorderHandleAriaLabel: (rowLabel: string, keyboardHint: string, disabledReason?: string) => string; rowReorderKeyboardHint: string; rowReorderMoved: (fromRowNumber: number, toPosition: number) => string; rowValidationError: string; save: string; saveNewRow: string; saveRow: (rowNumber: number) => string; selectAllRows: string; selectRow: (rowNumber: number) => string; sortOrder: (position: number) => string; toolbar: string; };
```

#### `GridToolbarContext`

The grid state and actions a toolbar template can use.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `addRowData` (read-only) | `Record<PropertyKey, unknown> \| null` | The new row's values while a row is being added, otherwise `null`. |
| `addRowVisible` (read-only) | `boolean` | Whether the add row is open. |
| `dataState` (read-only) | `GridDataState` | The current paging, sorting and filtering. |
| `editSession` (read-only) | `GridEditSession \| null` | The current edit, or `null` when nothing is being edited. |
| `selectedKeys` (read-only) | `readonly unknown[]` | The selected row keys. |

**Methods**

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cancelAdd(): boolean` | Closes the add row without saving. Returns whether it closed. |
| `cancelEdit(): boolean` | Ends the current cell or row edit without saving. Returns whether an edit was cancelled. |
| `saveAdd(): boolean` | Saves the add row. Returns whether it was saved. |
| `startAdd(): boolean` | Opens the add row. Returns whether it opened. |

#### `RowReorderableOptions`

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `canReorder?` | `(rowData: Record<PropertyKey, unknown>) => boolean` | Determines whether an individual row may be reordered. Rows for which this returns false must show a disabled handle. |
| `enabled?` | `boolean` | Enables row reordering. |
| `rowAriaLabel?` | `(rowData: Record<PropertyKey, unknown>, absoluteIndex: number) => string` | Returns the accessible label fragment for a row's reorder handle. Locale-aware composition supplies sentence punctuation, keyboard instructions, and disabled reasons around this fragment. The default must be positional, such as: "Reorder row 3" |

#### `SelectableOptions`

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled?` | `boolean` | Enables row selection. |
| `mode?` | `"single" \| "multiple"` | Controls whether one or multiple rows can be selected. |
| `rowAriaLabel?` | `(rowData: Record<PropertyKey, unknown>) => string` | Derives the accessible label for a row's selection checkbox from its data. When omitted, the checkbox falls back to a positional label (e.g. "Select row 3"). |
| `selectAllScope?` | `"page" \| "view"` | Determines which rows are affected by the header checkbox. - "page": rows on the current paginated page - "view": all rows in the current filtered and sorted view For virtual scrolling, "page" resolves to the complete current view because virtual scrolling does not have logical pages. |
| `selectOnRowClick?` | `boolean` | Whether clicking the row itself changes selection. Off by default so that clicking a row to interact with its content (a link, a button, an editable cell) never silently discards the current selection. Set this to true to also select rows via a plain click, in addition to checkboxes or application code. |
| `showCheckboxes?` | `boolean` | Displays the built-in checkbox selection column. |
| `showSelectAll?` | `boolean` | Displays a select-all checkbox in the selection-column header. Only applies to multiple-selection mode. |

#### `SortableOptions`

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allowUnsort?` | `boolean` | Whether a third click on a sorted column clears its sort. |
| `enabled?` | `boolean` | Whether sorting is active. On unless set to `false`; options replace earlier ones. |
| `mode?` | `"single" \| "multiple"` | Whether one or several columns can be sorted at once. |
| `showIndices?` | `boolean` | Whether sort order indices are displayed on header cells. |

#### `ColumnFormat`

A date format string (date, datetime and time columns), or a formatter function.

```typescript
type ColumnFormat = string | ColumnFormatFunction;
```

#### `ColumnFormatFunction`

Formats a cell's value for display. Written in method form so a formatter typed for the column's own
value (`(value: number) => string`) is accepted.

```typescript
type ColumnFormatFunction = { format(value: unknown, row: Record<PropertyKey, unknown>, column: Column): string; }["format"];
```

#### `ColumnKind`

```typescript
type ColumnKind = "command" | "data";
```

#### `ColumnSortComparator`

Compares two cell values for sorting: negative, zero or positive, as for `Array.prototype.sort`.

```typescript
type ColumnSortComparator = { compare(left: unknown, right: unknown): number }["compare"];
```

#### `GridCancelReason`

Why an edit is being canceled: `"command"` for the Cancel button or `cancel()` in a template, `"escape"` for
the Escape key, `"switch"` when another edit or the add row starts, `"removed"` when the edited row left the
data or the view. A `"removed"` cancel can't be prevented: the row is gone.

```typescript
type GridCancelReason = "command" | "escape" | "removed" | "switch";
```

#### `GridColumnLockedPosition`

```typescript
type GridColumnLockedPosition = "left" | "right";
```

#### `GridEditOperation`

```typescript
type GridEditOperation = "create" | "update";
```

```typescript
type GridEditSchemaFactory = ( context: GridEditFormContext ) => SchemaOrSchemaFn<Record<PropertyKey, unknown>> | null | undefined;
```

#### `GridKeySelector`

The field holding a row's key, or a function returning it.

```typescript
type GridKeySelector<TData, TKey = unknown> = string | Selector<TData, TKey> | null;
```

#### `GridRowClass`

Returns the classes to add to the data row that shows the given item.

```typescript
type GridRowClass<TData> = (data: TData) => GridRowClassValue;
```

#### `GridRowClassValue`

The classes a `GridRowClass` function adds to a data row. Nullish values add nothing.

```typescript
type GridRowClassValue = string | readonly string[] | null | undefined;
```

#### `GridRowCommand`

A row command button: Edit, Remove, Save or Cancel.

```typescript
type GridRowCommand = "cancel" | "edit" | "remove" | "save";
```

#### `GridSaveOperation`

```typescript

```

#### `GridStateFilterValue`

```typescript

```

#### `GridStateLoadStatus`

The outcome of loading a state. `rejected-invalid`: the state isn't a well-formed `GridState` (a missing
array, a duplicate column id, an unknown filter operator, a page size or width that isn't a positive
number), and nothing was changed.

```typescript
type GridStateLoadStatus = "applied" | "empty" | "rejected-invalid" | "rejected-schema" | "rejected-version";
```

```typescript
type GridStateVersion = 1;
```
